probes.text: In Braavos, blinded Arya begs on the street; each day a young woman beats her with a staff.
Jorah and Daario are still out in the grasslands, following the trail left behind by Daenerys.
Tyrion, carrying a torch, edges into the dark catacombs beneath Meereen to speak with the two chained dragons.
Cersei and Jaime walk uninvited into a small council meeting, her towering silent bodyguard standing behind them.
In King's Landing, the High Sparrow takes the young king aside and preaches to him at length.

fine_only.text: Aboard a ship heading south, Sam tells Gilly he means to leave her and the baby with his family.

probes.text: Margaery is escorted down to Loras's cell and allowed a brief visit with her brother.
In Braavos, Arya is given a new target: an actress with a travelling theatre company.
On the shore of the Iron Islands, the ironborn assemble for a kingsmoot to choose Balon's successor.

fine_only.text: In Meereen, Tyrion and Varys receive a red priestess who has travelled to preach on Daenerys's behalf.

probes.text: At Horn Hill, Sam's father demeans him at the table as a soft bookworm and insults Gilly for being a Wildling.
Jaime and Bronn ride into the muddy siege camp outside Riverrun, where Jaime takes charge of the besieging forces.
Theon and Yara spend a last night ashore in Volantis with their crew before their ships sail on.
Jon, Sansa and Davos travel from hall to hall in the North, asking house after house for fighting men.
Varys says his farewells in Meereen and takes ship, staying vague with Tyrion about his errand.
Brienne is admitted into Riverrun to sit down with Sansa's grizzled great-uncle and argue for the castle.
Outside Winterfell, the Stark and Bolton armies form up facing each other across a wide open field.
Samwell and Gilly, with Little Sam, finally reach the Citadel in Oldtown after their long journey south.
